# Enhanced model diagnostics (deprecated)

<small>Source: [`R/validation.R`](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/heteroTests/blob/main/R/validation.R) · Help: `?checkModelEnhanced`</small>

Deprecated since 0.14.0: use `checkModel(model, data, enhanced = TRUE)`,
which runs the same checks. This name still works and warns.

## Usage

```r
checkModelEnhanced(model, data = NULL)
```

## Arguments

`model`
:   Fitted model supplied to subsequent diagnostics.

`data`
:   Optional `data.frame` used when fitting `model`. When provided it
    enables multicollinearity checks via [`performVIFDiagnostic()`](performVIFDiagnostic.md).

## Value

Invisibly returns `model` after issuing any relevant warnings.

## Details

Extends [`checkModel()`](checkModel.md) with additional soft checks that flag potential
numerical issues before computationally expensive diagnostics are executed.
The helper mirrors the warnings used throughout the package and retains the
original return semantics for backward compatibility.

The function warns when residual degrees of freedom fall below six, when a
near-perfect fit is detected (R\(^2 > 0.999\)), or when variance inflation
factors (VIFs) exceed 10. The latter threshold follows the regression
diagnostics literature (Belsley et al., 1980).

## References

Belsley, D. A., Kuh, E., & Welsch, R. E. (1980). *Regression Diagnostics:
Identifying Influential Data and Sources of Collinearity*. Wiley.

## See also

[`checkModel()`](checkModel.md), [`performVIFDiagnostic()`](performVIFDiagnostic.md), [`validateTestInputs()`](validateTestInputs.md)

## Examples

```r
data(mtcars)
fit <- stats::lm(mpg ~ wt + hp, data = mtcars)
checkModel(fit, enhanced = TRUE)
```
